request.initial_inventory_origin: model generated from registered initial frame only; no oracle, goal, label or manually correct region
request.prompt: From this initial RGB scene, describe up to five non-robot physical objects, assemblies, and visible components. Use shape and color, and distinguish a visibly connected component from a standalone item. Use part_of="unknown" when attachment cannot be seen, null for a clearly standalone item, otherwise a listed parent object ID. These are visual hypotheses, not hidden physical facts. Do not describe goals, task plans, actions or affordances. Return only a JSON object with exact keys objects and coverage. objects is 1..5 items with exact keys id (unique o0..o4), description (string max120), part_of (parent ID, "unknown", or null), visible_state (string max120). Parent links must not cycle. coverage is complete|overflow|occluded|unknown. The first character must be {; use no markdown or fences.
